about.body: AnimAlc is an anime client that plays content from public third-party APIs. The catalogue, metadata and video links come from those services.
about.privacyBody: Watch history, favourites, achievements, appearance and settings stay on your device. No account is required and no analytics are collected.
about.sourcesBody: AniLiberty provides the catalogue, voiceovers and HLS streams. Anime365 adds Russian voiceovers and metadata. Shikimori enriches titles, genres and scores. AniDUB answers 401 without a personal token and stays disabled.
